sources.label: Official A&F UK size guide (women's tops, product-page Size & Fit, UK region, cm)

audit: Was XXS–XXL with single bust/waist/hips values and US/EU sizes not on the UK chart. Official A&F UK women's tops chart publishes only chest (cm ranges) and UK size per A&F size, XXS–XXXL; waist/hips/US/EU removed. UK sizes changed (e.g. XXS was UK 6 → 4-6, L was UK 14 → 14-16, XL 16 → 18-20). The old /help-size-guide URLs no longer resolve.
notes: US casual brand. The official UK tops chart runs XXS–XXXL and gives chest only: XXS = UK 4-6, XS = UK 8, S = UK 10, M = UK 12, L = UK 14-16, XL = UK 18-20. Knits run more generously than wovens. Denim sold by waist/inseam inch measurement separately.
